title: Housing Price Prediction
description: This project builds a regression model that predicts house prices based on a dataset of housing features. It involves data exploration, preprocessing (handling missing values, feature transformations), feature engineering, and model selection/training using machine learning algorithms in Python (e.g., linear regression, tree‑based regressors). The workflow demonstrates an end‑to‑end machine learning pipeline from raw data through to predictive output and evaluation.
